name: 311 Service Assistant
headline: One civic number, from question to completed request.
prompt: What can your local government help you with today?
description: Answers common civic questions, routes requests, guides multi-step services, and captures reports through a single public number. Adapt the service catalogue and escalation rules to local requirements.
readiness: Illustrative workflow; validate service coverage, accessibility, location handling, and departmental escalation rules.

business.application: Answer civic questions, route requests, guide multi-step applications, and capture reports through one public number.
business.roi: Deflect routine calls, extend service hours, and complete more constituent requests on first contact.
business.metrics: Containment · Request completion · Time to resolution

technical.systems: Knowledge base · 311 or case system · Department directory
technical.build: Grounded answers, service-request intake, location capture, departmental routing, and escalation.

expected.description: Poster image for the video player (WebP).
